launcher.notes: YOUR EXACT JAR, FROM OUR GITHUB - the client jar is now the byte-exact ForgeOptiFine 1.8.9.jar from your real TLauncher folder (= the official Minecraft 1.8.9 client, sha1 3870888a6c3d349d3771a3e9d16c9bf5e076b908, 8,461,484 bytes). The launcher downloads it from the dedicated minecraft-1.8.9 GitHub release FIRST (the same mechanism as every other game file), then raw + four jsDelivr CDNs + github raw, with Mojang CDN last; the jar is also bundled inside the launcher itself (checksum-gated) so installs work fully offline. Every attempt is size+sha1-verified and a corrupted jar self-heals. Your jar, the Forge universal jar, the OptiFine jar and the launch arguments are all now byte/token-identical to TLauncher - if FPS still feels lower, it is the game profile video settings (each launcher has its own options.txt): set render distance and the OptiFine Performance toggles once in Video Settings. Restart the launcher, accept the update prompt, press PLAY.

notes: Client 3.6.3 "Unlock FPS + Use VBOs default ON": your requested default configuration is back - "Unlock FPS" is enabled by default (in-game ~260 fps ceiling, client menus stay capped at 60 fps so Cosmetics stays smooth) and "Use VBOs" is enabled by default (re-applied once automatically if 3.6.2 turned it off on your device). Both toggles keep working normally and your choices persist. Also fixed: a duplicated "Minimal View Bobbing" option meant fresh installs still had the Video Settings View Bobbing button flipping back OFF - one registration now, View Bobbing changes properly on every install. Launcher 2.7.15 unchanged.
